text: look ye so sadly today?: Heb. are your faces evil?
lift up thine head: Or, reckon
think on me: Heb. remember me with thee
white baskets: Or, full of holes
bakemeats for Pharaoh: Heb. meat of Pharaoh, the work of a baker, or cook
lift up thy head from off thee: Or, reckon thee, and take thy office from thee
